ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

breadcrumb.basic-note: A simple hierarchy with links for parent levels and text for the current page.
breadcrumb.description: Hierarchical navigation with links, icons, separators, overflow, and optional previous/next controls.

examples.note: Start with the default trail, then explore separators, density, and overflow below.

breadcrumb.icons-note: Items can be text-only, icon-only, or combine icon and text.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

breadcrumb.navigation-note: Previous and next chevron buttons can be displayed next to the breadcrumb.
breadcrumb.overflow-note: Limit visible items and collapse the start, middle, or end segment into an ellipsis menu.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

breadcrumb.separators-note: Choose slash, chevron, or center-dot separators.

size-density.note: Size scales text and icons while density controls the gap between items. Combine both controls to see every combination.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.truncation-note: Long labels truncate with an ellipsis and expose the full text through the native tooltip.
